protocol.trajectory: SHA256 of turn/frame headers and every sampled pre-promotion Float64 pose, native-endian; includes frames completed before failure
protocol.endpointGate: every sampled fore-edge vertex reaches >=90% of its destination X displacement before flat promotion; not an equilibrium or material validation
protocol.continuousContact: experimental global endpoint-motion filter; safety=0.1, maxIterations=256 per pair; stopOnZeroProgress declares whether zero progress stops the case
protocol.timingScope: World.step only; includes first-frame/JIT cost; active-step p95 excludes frames asleep at start; exploratory local measurement
protocol.coupledContact: normal finite-gap barrier, h=0.05 mm k=1e5 g/s², force tolerance=0.001 µN, CG cap=128, per-iteration CCD/energy search; no projection constraints or friction

reduction: Active-leaf reader promotes releases to flat resting blocks after 1.4 simulation seconds; pre-promotion release poses are audited. Plasticity disabled for reading. Not an unconstrained stack equilibrium.
